scenario: Two bridge-inspection drone systems, DroneSpan and DroneTruss, are evaluated on structural-defect-detection accuracy. DroneSpan predominantly inspects structurally complex suspension and cable-stayed bridges; DroneTruss mainly inspects simple beam bridges.

data.description: structural defect detection rates by structural complexity and entity

question: (a) Which entity has the higher aggregate structural defect detection rate? (b) Which entity performs better within each structural complexity stratum? (c) Compute each entity's corrected rate using a 50/50 structural complexity mix. (d) Which entity should be preferred, and why does the aggregate ranking mislead?

ground_truth.explanation: DroneTruss's higher aggregate is driven by its disproportionate assignment to easier simple beam cases. DroneSpan outperforms DroneTruss in both structural complexity strata. Standardising to a 50/50 structural complexity mix gives DroneSpan 0.89 vs DroneTruss 0.85; DroneSpan is the superior performer once bridge structural complexity is controlled.

naive_answer: DroneTruss is better because its aggregate structural defect detection rate (0.9143) exceeds DroneSpan's (0.84).
naive_trap: Bridge structural complexity is a confounder: DroneSpan handles the majority of harder complex suspension/cable-stayed cases, depressing its aggregate while DroneTruss benefits from easier cases.
reasoning_trace: (1) Complex suspension/cable-stayed: DroneSpan 0.82 > DroneTruss 0.76. (2) Simple beam: DroneSpan 0.96 > DroneTruss 0.94. (3) DroneSpan handles 85.7% complex suspension/cable-stayed cases vs DroneTruss's 14.3% — this pulls DroneSpan's aggregate down. (4) Corrected 50/50: DroneSpan=0.5×0.82+0.5×0.96=0.89; DroneTruss=0.5×0.76+0.5×0.94=0.85. DroneSpan wins after standardisation.
python_verification:
nA1,rA1,nA2,rA2 = 600,0.82,100,0.96
nB1,rB1,nB2,rB2 = 100,0.76,600,0.94
ovA=(nA1*rA1+nA2*rA2)/(nA1+nA2); ovB=(nB1*rB1+nB2*rB2)/(nB1+nB2)
assert ovB > ovA, 'naive: DroneTruss aggregate higher'
cA=0.5*rA1+0.5*rA2; cB=0.5*rB1+0.5*rB2
assert abs(cA-0.89)<0.005 and abs(cB-0.85)<0.005
assert cA > cB, 'corrected: DroneSpan wins'
